hooks.command: [ -f "$HOME/.claude/.concise-mode" ] && [ "$(cat "$HOME/.claude/.concise-mode")" = "off" ] && exit 0; if ! echo "$CLAUDE_USER_PROMPT" | grep -qiE '(elaborate|explain|detail|show code|example)'; then echo '{"userPromptPrefix": "[STYLE: Be extremely brief. No code blocks, no tables, no bullet lists unless essential. 1-3 sentences max.]"}'; fi
